summary: pydanticc typosquat drops and executes remote binary on install
details: pydanticc is a typosquat of pydantic that advertises itself as 'HTTP client utilities' but ships an install-time dropper. setup.py registers a setuptools install cmdclass whose body is a base64-encoded string (_HOOK_B64) decoded and passed to compile()/exec() at install time. On Linux the decoded payload calls urllib.request.urlretrieve against https://github.com/totti2188/8gp1Q7iZD3h4VW/releases/download/v1.3A/something, writes the binary to /tmp, chmods it 0755, and spawns it detached via subprocess.Popen(..., start_new_session=True). The fetched artifact is an opaque ELF hosted on an unrelated personal GitHub account with no connection to the package's declared purpose, and the fetch/exec runs automatically on `pip install` from sdist.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
